mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) > 0 FROM users WHERE (email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL) OR (original_email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at > NOW() - INTERVAL 15 DAY)
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET original_email = email, deleted_at = NOW(), email = CONCAT('deleted_', user_id, '@deleted.com') WHERE user_id = #{userId}
